title: taxus baccata subsp. minor
intro: Taxus baccata subsp. minor, commonly known as the small-leaved yew, is a subspecies of the yew plant, characterized by its small, dark green leaves. The health benefits of Taxus baccata subsp. minor include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include taxanes such as taxol, that have been shown to have anti-cancer and immunomodulatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Taxus baccata subsp. minor also include alkaloids, terpenes, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
